title: The Truth on the Chessboard
next_chapter_hook: The ancient will dormant within Chen Ji's body for ten thousand years let out a roar that shattered the heavens—the chess game he failed to break eons ago must end this lifetime!

text.content: The instant that gaze fell upon him, Chen Ji felt as if all his disguises were stripped away—skin, bones, meridians, even the most hidden corners of his consciousness, nothing escaped that scrutiny. This wasn't ordinary probing but some kind of transcendent 'examination,' like a chess player studying a piece about to be placed on the board. 'Finally... noticed me?' Chen Ji whispered in his heart, though a self-mocking curve touched his lips. After all these years of feigning weakness to strike later, he thought he was cautious enough, yet he'd never truly escaped that chess player's vision.

dialogue.content: 'Interesting little creature.' The voice didn't come from outside but echoed directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, calm as an ancient well, devoid of any emotion, yet every strand of his spiritual sense trembled. 'The seventeenth-generation inheritor of the Tianji Record, yet still a wretch who hasn't even achieved Foundation Building. Cang Yutian's... judgment, is becoming more and more disappointing.'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer. He was waiting—for that high-and-mighty chess player to reveal more flaws. Deep within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, as if terrified by its host's disrespect. And Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a barely audible sigh: 'It's here... it's finally here.' Chen Ji sneered in his heart. Fine, since you're here, let me see how deep this so-called 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets' can truly see.

In an instant, the complete picture of the ancient chess game unfolded before his eyes—not fuzzy outlines but the truth in perfect detail. The chessboard was vast beyond all his imagination. Countless light points dotted it like stars, each one a manipulated thread of fate. And on that board, he saw two most glaring light points—one emanating a faint cyan glow, the other burning with blinding golden flames. Between those two points stretched an invisible thread, and that thread bore the name 'Heavenly Fate.'

dialogue.content: 'See it now?' That voice carried a hint of amusement. 'The cyan light is Chen Ji, the golden flame is Chen Tianming. Twin Fates, born of the same source, connected by the same breath. You were designed with only one purpose—to become the most perfect 'deciding move' of this chess game.' After a pause, a cruel smile crept into that voice. 'Unfortunately, Cang Yutian lost. The 'Central Son' Chen Tianming he cultivated was intercepted by the Fate Writer three thousand years ago. And you...'

text.content: 'And I, am the discarded piece?' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, yet his knuckles whitened within his sleeves. He thought of Chen Tianming's warm, jade-like face, of how the other always seemed to 'coincidentally' appear at crucial moments, of those grand opportunities he'd attributed to 'protagonist's luck.' So from the very beginning, the 'opponent' he thought he had was just another manipulated wretch. And he himself wasn't even worthy of being called an opponent—just a backup piece, a discarded pawn, not even qualified to sit on the board.

Rage churned in his chest like magma. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the fury that threatened to shatter his reason. Remember your grudges, but never act rashly. He repeated to himself. Chen Xuan had taught him this, Mo Xiansheng had taught him this—to be angry at any time is the cheapest emotion. True revenge means watching your enemies despair as you rise step by step to heights they can never reach. But now, facing this truth beyond comprehension, he felt those principles waver for the first time.

dialogue.content: 'Discarded piece?' That voice sounded as if it had heard a hilarious joke, letting out a cold chuckle of derision. 'No, you are not a discarded piece. You are 'insurance.' After Chen Tianming was intercepted, Cang Yutian secretly left a hidden piece—a branch family son from the Chen clan, sent to the Tianqing Sect to live as a servant, hidden under the name of atrash. What he waited for was the fall of another 'Heavenly Fate Son.' At that time, you, this 'remnant fragment of Twin Fates,' would be his last chance to turn the tables.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Servant status,trash reputation... he thought that was the path he'd chosen, the wisdom of feigning weakness to devour tigers, yet from the very start his script had been arranged by others. He thought of those moments when he'd 'coincidentally' obtained the Tianji Record, of every life-or-death opportunity that had saved him—so it turned out everything was the Chess Player's layout, even his own 'rebellion' was within the plan. Heh, what a fine 'chance to turn the tables.' He laughed softly, laughter carrying an indescribable bitterness and sorrow.

And when he cast his gaze toward the higher reaches of the chessboard, fury nearly consumed him. Above that ancient chess game, he saw two existences transcending all—the first radiating an aura vast and profound as an abyss, the second burning with fierce brilliance like the sun. Those were Cang Yutian and the Fate Writer. The two ultimate Chess Players sat across from each other in the void, their game spanning hundreds of millions of years. And their stakes in this game were not resources, not territories—the fates of all beings under their dominion. Including Chen Ji, including Chen Tianming, including everyone in this world.

choice.prompt: Facing this designed truth, Chen Ji's heart churned with boundless fury. Three paths lay before him:

choices.description: Since I'm a chess piece, I'll overturn the board! Since I'm being designed, I'll break the design! For hundreds of millions of years no one could break this ancient chess game, but I, Chen Ji, will be the one to try.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all Heavenly Fate Value, may trigger deadly backlash
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the 'Destiny Defier' achievement, gain full recognition from the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Success rate unknown, but failure means complete annihilation of body and spirit

text.content: 'Bold.' Chen Ji's voice exploded within his Mental Sea, startling even that gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets into a momentary pause. 'Hundreds of millions of years of planning, hundreds of millions of years of scheming, treating all living beings as chess pieces, making supreme geniuses into toys—you must be very proud?' His lips curved into a razor-sharp arc, flames of madness burning in his eyes. 'Unfortunately, you've miscalculated one thing.'

'I, Chen Ji, have never been anyone's chess piece.' Before the words even finished echoing, he forcefully activated the Tianji Record Fragment, transforming his spiritual sense into a blade that stabbed directly toward the heart of the ancient chess game. In that instant, heaven and earth changed color, wind and clouds churned. Those two ultimate existences cast their gazes simultaneously—one with surprise, one with interest. On the chessboard, countless threads of fate trembled violently, as if something was about to break free.

choices.description: Since everything was destined long ago, aren't all my struggles merely jokes? Perhaps... accepting one's fate is the best choice. At least I can keep this life.
choices.visible_cost: Lose self-awareness, become a true chess piece
choices.visible_reward: Gain Cang Yutian's protection to a certain extent, short-term safety guaranteed
choices.risk_hint: Forever lose the chance to break destiny, become the next 'Chen Tianming'
choices.process_label: seek last freedom in the chess game

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze gradually dimmed. Accept your fate, he told himself in his heart. For hundreds of millions of years, no one has been able to break this chess game. You, a waste who hasn't even reached Foundation Building, what makes you think you can? Perhaps Cang Yutian was right—you are just a spare chess piece. A chess piece should have the觉悟—lie quietly, waiting to be moved or discarded. This is the smartest choice.

However, just as he was about to lower his head, a weak sigh echoed from the depths of his Mental Sea. That was the trembling of the Tianji Record Fragment, the whispered remnants of Mo Xiansheng's soul: 'Child... are you truly going to give up? Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan faced the same choice. He chose... are you certain you want to repeat his fate?'

choices.description: The game between two supreme chess players must inevitably contain a third possibility. I won't overturn the board, nor will I be a chess piece—I want to find that third path, the one even they never anticipated.
choices.visible_cost: Requiring alliance with all those who have been manipulated, difficulty is extremely high
choices.visible_reward: May find the true method to break the chess game, gaining the identity of 'Variable'
choices.risk_hint: Once discovered, will simultaneously offend two supreme existences
choices.process_label: weave weakling's game in the cracks

text.content: The confusion in Chen Ji's eyes lasted only a moment. In the next instant, his gaze sharpened once more. Since the two supreme chess players had been locked in battle for hundreds of millions of years without determining a victor, it proved—the chess game itself had flaws. He began rapidly deducing within his Mental Sea, countless thoughts intertwining like lightning. Those allies he had drawn to his side, those seemingly coincidental opportunities, those hidden pieces he had planted...

Ye Qing's Demonic Path mists can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, Su Qingyao's 'Shared Destiny' can share the Heavenly Fate consumption, Chen Nian's existence can disrupt foresight... I am not fighting alone. Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice growing more resolute. You want to treat me as a chess piece? Fine, I'll make all these chess pieces rebel. Cang Yutian and the Fate Writer... wait and see. I'll show you what it means when 'clever scheming leads to one's own downfall.'

Just then, a subtle change occurred on the chessboard. That point of light blazing with golden flames—Chen Tianting—suddenly剧烈跳动起来, as if sensing something. At the same moment, countless points marked as 'Key Nodes' simultaneously dimmed—those were the hidden pieces Chen Ji had laid over the past decades. He abruptly realized that every 'move' he had made was under the observation of the two supreme chess players. They weren't watching his performance—they were appreciating his performance.

A mocking voice echoed: 'What amusing struggle.' The Voice of the Heavenly Eye spoke again,带着一丝meaningful的嘲弄. 'You think you're making moves, when in reality you're merely adding some entertainment to our mundane existence. Hundreds of millions of years of chess, we always need some seasoning. And you—' The voice paused, 'are the most interesting chess piece in ten thousand years. At least, your anger is genuine.' Chen Ji felt an unprecedented humiliation surge through him. His anger is genuine? Hmph, then let me show you—can this genuine anger burn through your false天道!

However, just as he was about to explode, a dull roar echoed from the depths of his Mental Sea. That wasn't Mo Xiansheng's voice, nor the trembling of the Tianji Record Fragment—that was something far more ancient, far more terrifying. Like a beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years, suddenly and completely awakened. 'Again... this kind of gaze...' An aged yet violent voice exploded within the deepest depths of Chen Ji's soul, 'Ten thousand years... they're still playing these tricks... still treating all living beings as chess pieces...'

dialogue.content: The voice trembled with unprecedented agitation. A cosmic observation froze in place, confronting something seemingly impossible. 'This aura... cannot be... that existence, wasn't it completely annihilated ten thousand years ago?!' On the chessboard, gazes from two ultimate beings simultaneously fixed upon Chen Ji—one carrying deep suspicion, the other... naked greed. 'Interesting... most interesting...'

text.content: Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea seemingly occupied by two distinctly different forces simultaneously. On one side was the cold scrutiny of the Heavenly Eye; on the other, the searing howl of that ancient will from the depths of his consciousness. The collision of these two forces sent his divine sense into violent turmoil, blood seeping from all seven orifices. Yet precisely this excruciating pain allowed him to grasp a crucial piece of information amid the chaos—the ancient will was attempting to convey something to him. '...break... the chess game... method...'

choice.prompt: The ancient will is awakening, the gazes of two ultimate existences simultaneously locked onto Chen Ji. This is the critical choice determining the direction of fate:

choices.description: That ancient will seems to know the method to break the chess game. Since even the Heavenly Eye was shaken by it, take the gamble—merge with it, gain the power of ten thousand years ago!
choices.visible_cost: May lose self-consciousness, being replaced by the ancient will
choices.visible_reward: Obtain ancient power inheritance, unlocking the 'Ancient Will' skill
choices.risk_hint: The fusion process is extremely dangerous, success rate less than thirty percent

text.content: Do you want to break this chess game? That aged voice reverberated through Chen Ji's Mental Sea. 'Then let me... become your strength!' Before the words finished, a vast ocean-like stream of information flooded into Chen Ji's divine sense. These were memory fragments from ten thousand years ago—a powerful being who dared challenge the two supreme chess players, a history of struggle that was forcibly erased, and... an earth-shattering secret.

choices.description: That power is too overwhelming, I cannot determine if it can be trusted. Perhaps... I should break this chess game through my own strength.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to gain a powerful ally
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute control of one's own will, gaining a certain degree of recognition from the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Facing two ultimate existences alone brings immense pressure

text.content: "No." Chen Ji shouted in his heart, "I don't know who you are, nor your purpose. Before I understand everything, I won't let any existence enter my Mental Sea." That ancient will seemed stunned for a moment, then let out a desolate laugh: "Haha... good... what a cautious little one... but remember, this Chess Game... is not your battle alone..."

choices.description: Neither completely merging nor completely rejecting. I will negotiate with it—you have your purpose, I have my demands. Since we both want to break the Chess Game, let's cooperate once.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally-level existence while retaining self-awareness and obtaining additional assistance
choices.risk_hint: Playing with a tiger—by its very nature, it is a terrifying existence from ten thousand years ago
choices.process_label: wisdom as currency, seek mutual victory

text.content: "What do you want?" Chen Ji's voice regained its composure, that calculating nature of his reasserting dominance, "You failed ten thousand years ago. Now you want to use my body to revive? Speak—how can we benefit from this." That ancient will fell silent for a moment, then let out a low laugh: "Clever... you're smarter than I was back then... fine, I'll tell you a secret—there is a fatal flaw in this Chess Game..."

"Enough." The Heavenly Eye's voice turned icy cold, that gaze transcending time and space now carrying genuine killing intent, "Whatever you harbor within you, I will not allow a third variable to appear in the Chess Game." The moment those words fell, Chen Ji felt a world-destroying pressure descending from the heavens, as if the entire world was crushing down upon him. Yet in that critical moment, the ancient will deep within his Mental Sea erupted with a roar that shattered the heavens—"Ten thousand years ago I failed to break this Chess Game—this life... I will never repeat that mistake!"
